content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Courses teachable

Platforms like Teachable, Stripe, and Gumroad provide user-friendly interfaces and built-in payment processing that make selling digital products seem effortless. However, their limitations quickly become apparent when you consider their geographical restrictions. In contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructure offers a robust solution that empowers creators to build their own online stores. By leveraging tools like Cloudflare Pages, Workers, and NOWPayments, you can take full control of your sales process, ensuring that no matter where you are, you can sell your courses without reliance on external platforms.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Traditional platforms often exclude entire regions due to regulatory concerns, leaving creators in countries like Nigeria and Pakistan unable to use their services. Stripe and PayPal have stringent requirements that many cannot meet, resulting in a frustrating cycle of rejection. When these platforms suspend accounts, as PayPal does for up to 180 days without the possibility of appeal, creators are left in limbo. In contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructure enables creators to operate independently of these constraints. By setting up a system with NOWPayments, you can accept payments in multiple cryptocurrencies, ensuring that your revenue stream remains intact regardless of your geographical location.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Payment processing speed and fees are crucial factors for digital creators. Stripe and PayPal may promise fast transactions, but they often come with hidden fees and withdrawal delays. For instance, a PayPal account suspension can prevent access to funds for months. On the other hand, using NOWPayments with sovereign commerce infrastructure comes with a transparent fee of just 0.5% and allows instant access to your funds upon confirmation of payment. Moreover, by operating on networks like BSC or Solana, transaction costs can be kept under $0.10, making it a more economical choice for creators.
Full ownership of your digital sales means no more platform restrictions.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

One of the most significant advantages of sovereign commerce infrastructure is ownership. With platforms like Stripe and Teachable, you are essentially renting space on their ecosystem, which means they retain control over your data and transactions. Once you deploy a solution like the Edge Commerce Stack, you have full ownership of your digital storefront. This architecture not only automates payment processing but also ensures instant delivery of your courses to customers. After deployment, you own everything, and there are no subscriptions or ongoing fees, making it a sustainable option for the long term.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

Choosing the right architecture depends largely on your specific needs as a digital creator. If you require a fast deployment and minimal setup, the Sovereign Starter Stack may suffice. However, if you are serious about scaling your business and ensuring robust functionality, the Edge Commerce Stack is the optimal choice. With comprehensive features including SPF/DKIM/DMARC configuration and end-to-end testing, it sets you up for success in a competitive digital marketplace. Ultimately, the decision comes down to whether you prefer reliance on traditional platforms or the autonomy offered by sovereign commerce.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

If Stripe is not available in your country, the best alternative is to utilize sovereign commerce infrastructure. This allows you to accept payments directly without the restrictions common with traditional platforms, offering you the freedom to sell your digital products globally. By leveraging tools like NOWPayments, you can seamlessly integrate cryptocurrency payments into your sales process.
Processing fees as low as 0.5% make your earnings more sustainable.

This solution provides everything needed to set up a fully functional online store without the limitations imposed by traditional payment processors. Your Deployment Checklist

Stop using a friend's account in another country — this violates platform terms and puts both accounts at risk. Create a NOWPayments merchant account under your own email — no KYC required, takes under 15 minutes. Configure wallet addresses for USDT on Tron as your primary coin and Bitcoin as your secondary. Deploy your backend — Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script Web App — and confirm the endpoint URL is accessible. Set the endpoint URL as the webhook URL in your NOWPayments IPN settings with the secret key configured in both places. Build or deploy your storefront on Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages. Run a mainnet test transaction — send a small amount of real USDT to your configured address, confirm the webhook fires, the order logs, and the delivery email arrives. Promote your store only after the complete test passes.
